today.title: Today
today.soon: Orders, customers and prices arrive in the next steps.

shops.title: Shops
shops.emptyDescription: Create the first shop and its owner.

newShop.title: New shop
newShop.description: The shop and its owner's account are created together. Give the owner the username and temporary password; they choose their own password at the first sign-in.
newShop.name: Shop name
newShop.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, like sokha-laundry. Can't be changed later.

shop.title: Shop
shop.resetPasswordDescription: Give the owner a new temporary password. They are signed out on every device and choose their own password at the next sign-in.
shop.passwordReset: The password was reset and the owner was signed out everywhere.
shop.revokeSessionsDescription: Use this when the owner's phone is lost. The password doesn't change.
shop.revokeSessionsConfirm: Sign the owner out on every device?
shop.sessionsRevoked: The owner was signed out everywhere.
shop.suspendDescription: The owner can still sign in but can't use the shop. Its ticket pages show "unavailable". Nothing is deleted.
shop.resumeDescription: The owner can use the shop again.
